content: shadcn/ui won via ownership model (copy-paste source, no dependency hell, no breaking-change risk), customization freedom, only-what-you-use bundle, and AI-tool compatibility (v0 made it default for AI-generated UIs). Implication for npm-first libraries: mitigate the ownership objection with CSS-first customization (all appearance in overridable CSS classes), thin wrappers, shadcn-compat token mapping, and a registry as phase 2.
